children: RNS Number : 2908D  Zenith Energy Ltd  16 November 2026
November 16, 2026
ZENITH ENERGY LTD.
("Zenith" or the "Company")
Resumption of Oil Production in Tunisia

Zenith Energy Ltd. (LSE: ZEN; OSE: ZENA; XSAT: ZENA SDR), the international energy production and development company, announces that its wholly owned subsidiary, Ecumed Petroleum Tunisia Ltd. (“EPT”), has successfully resumed oil production from the onshore Robbana concession in Tunisia.

Following indications from the Tunisian authorities that production and oil sales could resume without interference, EPT completed repairs to equipment damaged by vandalism, as previously announced on 14 April 2026. Production has now resumed at a rate of approximately 35 barrels of oil per day (“bopd”).

Zenith companies view this development as an encouraging first step towards the potential restoration of their wider operational activities in Tunisia. Zenith companies remain committed to their Tunisian portfolio and hope that the recent constructive engagement with the authorities may create opportunities for further progress across their other concessions.

Throughout the interruption to production and oil sales at Robbana and El Bibane, Zenith companies have continued to meet the necessary financial and operational obligations, including employee salaries, environmental compliance and technical maintenance. Cumulative expenditure on these activities amounts to approximately US$2.7 million.

These substantial expenditures demonstrate the continued commitment of Zenith companies to maintaining their operations, notwithstanding the ongoing arbitrary conduct of the Tunisian authorities. All such expenditures have been incurred without prejudice to the rights and claims of the Zenith companies in the ongoing arbitration proceedings against the Republic of Tunisia.
Andrea Cattaneo, Chief Executive Officer of Zenith, commented:
“The resumption of production at Robbana represents an important and encouraging development for Zenith's activities in Tunisia, where Zenith companies hold interests in oil and gas assets.

Despite the challenges we have faced, Zenith companies have continued to maintain their Tunisian assets, retain employees and meet their obligations, committing almost US$3 million to these operations during a prolonged period of interruption.

We are particularly encouraged by the recent improvement in our engagement with the Tunisian authorities, which we hope will mark the beginning of a more constructive phase in our relationship and potentially open the way for the progressive resumption of activities across our wider Tunisian portfolio.

We remain committed to our operations in Tunisia and look forward to building on this positive development, while continuing to protect the rights and interests of Zenith companies in the ongoing arbitration proceedings.”
